definitions.gloss: chugging; downing a drink in one go; draining a glass
definitions.explanation: The act of drinking an entire beverage without stopping, typically alcoholic drinks. Often done under social pressure at parties and gatherings.

examples.japanese: {一気飲|いっきの}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一気飲|いっきの}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強要|きょうよう}→強要：12538_kyouyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was pressured to chug at a college drinking party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急性|きゅうせい}→急性：09015_kyuusei⟧⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一気飲|いっきの}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}している→禁止する：22145_kinshisuru⟧。
examples.english: Because incidents of acute alcohol poisoning have continued, many universities have banned chugging.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A practice associated with Japanese drinking culture, particularly at university welcome parties ({新歓|しんかん}コンパ). It has been a serious social issue due to deaths from acute alcohol poisoning. Most universities and companies now prohibit it. The chant "⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧！⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧！" (Chug! Chug!) is used to pressure someone into drinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一気飲|いっきの}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to chug)
- {一気飲|いっきの}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強要|きょうよう}→強要：12538_kyouyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pressure someone to chug)
- {一気飲|いっきの}み⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (ban on chugging)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink in one go — verb phrase rather than noun
